# zig-gmp generated source manifest

# This file is generated by `zig build gen` (gen/gen.sh). It describes
# the sources, flags and include directories needed to build GNU MP
# 6.3.0 with any C compiler. It is intentionally line oriented and needs
# no parser.

# Format: one record per line, fields separated by spaces. Blank lines
# and lines starting with '#' are ignored. This is format version 1.

#   version <n>
#       Format version.

#   upstream <url> <hash>
#       The exact GMP source release. <hash> is the Zig package hash.

#   cflags <define>...
#       Definitions to pass to every C compilation.

#   include <root> <dir>
#       An include directory, in search order. <root> is "platform"
#       (the platform generated directory), "shared" (shared generated
#       files) or "source" (the GMP source tree). Add these in the
#       order given; generated entries must come before source ones.

#   shared-dir <dir>
#       Repository-relative directory used by the "shared" root.

#   common-c <path>
#       C source, relative to the GMP source root, compiled by every
#       platform.

#   common-generated <path>
#       C source, relative to <shared-dir>, compiled by every platform.

#   fallback-c <path>
#       Additional C source, relative to the GMP source root, used by
#       the "c" (no assembly) variant.

#   fallback-shared <path>
#       Additional C source, relative to <shared-dir>, used by the "c"
#       variant. These are the generated operation wrappers.

#   platform <arch> <os> <abis> <variant> <generated-dir>
#       Starts a platform block. <abis> is a comma-separated list of Zig
#       ABI names. <variant> is "asm" (C plus assembly) or "c" (C only).
#       All following records belong to this platform.

#   triple <target>
#       A Zig-style target triple served by the current platform block.

#   assembly-dir <dir>
#       Repository-relative directory for generated-asm records. Shared
#       by platforms with the same OS/CPU payload (for example gnu and
#       musl). The "generated-asm" paths are relative to this directory.

#   cflag <flag>
#       An extra flag for every C compilation on this platform.

#   source <path>
#       C source relative to the GMP source root.

#   shared <path>
#       C source relative to <shared-dir>.

#   generated-c <path>
#       C source relative to <generated-dir>.

#   generated-asm <path>
#       Assembly source relative to <assembly-dir>.

# Build notes:
#   - Compile common-c, common-generated, and (for the "c" variant)
#     fallback-c and fallback-shared, plus the platform's own units.
#   - Every record has a unique path. Do not merge records by basename;
#     GMP has same-named sources in different directories.
#   - Assembly units are already m4-expanded; do not run m4. Linux
#     assembly carries a .note.GNU-stack section, so no special linker
#     flag is needed.
#   - Place include directories in the listed order.
#   - No extra system libraries are needed to link libgmp.
